title: Tools Need Not Speak in Text: Latent Context Compression for Agents
reason_zh: 学习对象是神经压缩器的 LoRA 与 latent adapter 权重。正文给出冻结 target agent 下的梯度训练，推理期使用固定已训练压缩器；没有执行或评估反馈驱动地改写并跨轮保留提示、工具代码、技能或上下文管理机制的 Harness 演化证据。压缩器在后续任务复用不等于外部 Harness 工件被迭代修改。也不足以认定两轮模型权重 RSI。

quotes.quote: During training, we keep the target agent frozen and update only the LoRA parameters of the context-aware encoder and the parameters of the latent adapter.
Since latent tokens are continuous and differentiable, gradients can propagate through the frozen target agent to optimize the compression model:

During inference, the trained compressor replaces raw tool observations with latent tokens after each tool call, allowing the agent to perform multi-step interactions with a more compact context (Section 3.5 ).
